title: Graph Foundation Models Can Become Effective Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detectors
abstract: arXiv:2611.06441v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTSAD) relies on modeling both temporal dynamics and inter-sensor dependencies to identify complex system faults. Although graph-based detectors explicitly model sensor topologies, they train task-specific networks from scratch on limited target-domain data, remaining vulnerable to spurious correlations and unable to reuse transferable priors. While pretrained Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) offer transferable topological priors and anomaly discriminability, directly adapting them to MTSAD is hindered by cross-modal feature-topology mismatch, unreliable pseudo-anomaly supervision, and decision distortion during node-to-window aggregation. To fill these gaps, we propose a novel adaptation framework, Gfm4Mtsad, which unleashes pretrained GFMs for MTSAD. translated_title: 图基础模型可以成为有效的多变量时间序列异常检测器
translated_abstract: 多变量时间序列异常检测（MTSAD）依赖于对时间动态特性和传感器间依赖关系的建模，以识别复杂系统的故障。尽管基于图的检测器能够显式地建模传感器拓扑结构，但它们需要在有限的目标域数据上从头训练特定任务的网络，因此仍然容易受到虚假相关性的影响，并且无法复用可迁移的先验知识。虽然预训练的图基础模型（GFMs）提供了可迁移的拓扑先验和异常判别能力，但将其直接适配到MTSAD面临三大障碍：跨模态的特征-拓扑不匹配、不可靠的伪异常监督，以及节点到窗口聚合过程中的决策失真。为了填补这些空白，我们提出了一种新颖的适配框架Gfm4Mtsad，将预训练的图基础模型充分应用于多变量时间序列异常检测。我们引入了结构与信息契约对齐（SICA）模块，以桥接连续时间序列与预训练的图基础模型空间。该模块…
tldr: 提出Gfm4Mtsad适配框架，通过引入结构与信息契约对齐（SICA）模块，将预训练图基础模型成功迁移到多变量时间序列异常检测任务中，克服了跨模态不匹配、伪异常监督不可靠和决策失真三大挑战。
en_tdlr: Proposes Gfm4Mtsad, a novel adaptation framework that unleashes pretrained Graph Foundation Models for multivariate time series anomaly detection by introducing the Structure-and-Information Contract Alignment (SICA) module to bridge cross-modal gaps, addressing feature-topology mismatch, unreliable pseudo-anomaly supervision, and decision distortion.
